items.name: Shabbat services
items.text: Saturday 10 AM to 12 PM with a hot Kiddush lunch. Friday night Kabbalat Shabbat. Bilingual prayer book; children welcome.

items.name: Daily minyan
items.text: Monday to Friday 6:30 AM, Sunday 8:00 AM. Saying Kaddish? Let us know and we will make sure there is a minyan.

items.name: Shabbat candle lighting times
items.text: Times for Lafayette, Moraga and Orinda, every week.

items.name: Shabbat dinner with the Rabbi's family
items.text: Any week of the year. Just let us know you are coming.

items.name: Bay Kosher
items.text: Kosher meat, poultry, groceries, holiday foods and Judaica, ordered online and delivered. A project of Chabad of Lamorinda.

items.name: Kosher your kitchen
items.text: The Rabbi will happily help you kosher your kitchen, step by step, at your pace.

items.name: Mezuzahs
items.text: Buy a kosher mezuzah, have yours checked by a scribe, or get help putting them up with the blessing.

items.name: Tefillin
items.text: Put on tefillin with the Rabbi, have your tefillin checked, or get your own pair (also a beautiful bar mitzvah gift).

items.name: Shabbat candles and Judaica
items.text: Candlesticks, menorahs, Kiddush cups and more through Bay Kosher.

items.name: New baby: brit milah and baby naming
items.text: We help arrange a mohel for a bris and name your baby in the synagogue. Just had a baby and wondering what to do? Call us.

items.name: Bar & Bat Mitzvah
items.text: Personal preparation and a celebration to remember. Find the date with the [Bar/Bat Mitzvah calculator](/tools/bar-bat-mitzvah).

items.name: Jewish weddings
items.text: From the first conversation to the chuppah, the Rabbi is here to help.

items.name: Jewish funerals and the Chevra Kadisha
items.text: When a loved one passes, call the Rabbi at 925-384-7242 and we will guide the family through a dignified Jewish funeral, shiva and Kaddish.

items.name: Meet with the Rabbi
items.text: For advice, a question about Judaism, or just to talk. Confidential and judgment-free.

items.name: Yahrzeit calculator and reminders
items.text: Find the yahrzeit date for the next ten years and save it for an annual reminder.

items.name: Kaddish
items.text: We can make sure Kaddish is said for your loved one, and teach you to say it.

items.name: Sponsor a Kiddush in memory
items.text: Honor a loved one's memory by sponsoring the Shabbat Kiddush.

items.name: Weekly classes
items.text: Torah (Sunday), Hebrew class with a meal (Tuesday) and Tanya (Wednesday).

items.name: One-on-one learning
items.text: Choose any topic and study with the Rabbi at your own pace.

items.name: Lamorinda Jewish Preschool
items.text: Ages 12 months to 4 years, in Lafayette.

items.name: Lamorinda Hebrew School
items.text: Sundays 10 AM to 12 PM, ages 3 to 13.

items.name: CKids Afterschool
items.text: Ages 5 to 13, weekdays 3 to 6 PM.

items.name: Summer and winter camp
items.text: Jewish camp fun for little ones.

items.name: Lulav and etrog
items.text: Order your set for Sukkot.

items.name: Shmurah matzah and Seder-to-go
items.text: Handmade matzah and everything for your Seder.

items.name: Sell your chametz
items.text: Authorize the Rabbi to sell your chametz before Passover.

items.name: Menorahs and Chanukah candles
items.text: Get a menorah and candles for your home. Ask us.

items.name: Hebrew date converter
items.text: Convert any date to the Hebrew calendar.

items.name: Jewish holiday dates
items.text: Every holiday this year with Lamorinda candle lighting times.

items.name: Calendar subscription
items.text: Add all Chabad of Lamorinda events to your phone's calendar.
